note_en: 与其 A，不如 B means "rather than A, better B": 与其 introduces the option being rejected, 不如 the one chosen. In the text: 与其选一份稳定却没有挑战的工作，不如去一个能让我快速长大的地方 "rather than a stable job with no challenge, better to go somewhere I can grow up fast." At the end she repeats the frame as a life lesson: 与其等一个保证，不如先把手里的事做好 "rather than wait for a guarantee, better to do the work in front of you well."
